# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Druid level 8 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Druid
# level-1..level-7 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline to level 8 as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice
# seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat
# posture from the level-1..level-7 fixtures, and the same canonical
# nature-bond selection (animal companion), adding only the level bump this
# bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Druid burden surface: no animal
# companion stat block/advancement/link-share-spells, no wild shape
# execution (the PF1 CRB Druid class table's level-8 "Special" column reads
# "Wild shape (3/day)" — verified independently against both d20pfsrd and
# legacy.aonprd.com — but the rule text bundles that frequency increase with
# a form-list expansion (Huge/Diminutive animal, Medium elemental,
# Small/Medium plant) and functioning-level upgrades (beast shape III /
# elemental body II / plant shape I), none of which are separable from the
# "3/day" numeral without misrepresenting the bundled feature as flat, so
# this fixture makes no wild-shape claim either way, mirroring the level-4/6
# precedent exactly), no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell slots, no
# spell DCs, no bonus spells, and no level-9+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-druid-level8
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:druid:8
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:12
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:druid_nature_bond:bond:animal_companion
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
